title: Production corpus loaders
summary: Three corpora ship today as caller-injected stubs (citationGroundedFactual.CITATION_CORPUS demo seed; spVocabularyLibraryAudit caller-injected; pastPaperFrequencyAnchor caller-injected). H7 builds the production loaders: filesystem-backed JSON corpora with a refresh job + admin-panel staleness indicator + provenance metadata.

in: server/lib/subjectVocabularyCorpus.ts (new, ~200 LoC) — production loader; reads server/data/corpora/subject-vocab/*.json
server/lib/citationCorpus.ts (new, ~200 LoC) — production loader; reads server/data/corpora/citations/*.json
server/data/corpora/subject-vocab/*.json — seed data for ≥10 subjects × KS3/KS4 (paraphrased per existing curriculum-bank attribution rules)
server/data/corpora/citations/*.json — ≥500 verified citations (history dates, science values, lit quotes)
server/data/corpora/past-paper-frequency/*.json — frequency data 2019-2024 for AQA + Edexcel + OCR top GCSE subjects
scripts/refresh-corpora.mjs (new) — one-shot script the admin runs to refresh; outputs a manifest with last-updated date
client/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx — staleness indicator (any corpus >12 months stale shows a yellow banner)
Targeted vitest per loader: lazy-load semantics; staleness detection; missing-corpus fallback (returns empty corpus + warning)
out: Live corpus refresh from external APIs (deferred — admin runs the script manually for v1)

acceptance_criteria: Each loader returns the audit's existing expected shape; cited consumers (spVocabularyLibraryAudit, citationGroundedFactual, pastPaperFrequencyAnchor) work without source-file changes.
Loaders are idempotent — calling twice returns the same in-memory snapshot until refresh-corpora.mjs is run.
Refresh script outputs a manifest at server/data/corpora/manifest.json with per-corpus last-updated date.
Admin panel staleness banner fires when any corpus is >12 months stale.
All seed data is paraphrased from public sources with explicit per-entry source attribution (mirrors the curriculum-bank exemplar convention).

risk_register.risk: Corpus copyright — past-paper text or proprietary vocab lists
risk_register.mitigation: Every entry paraphrased; source attribution mandatory; no verbatim past-paper text; public-source-only vocab lists.

risk_register.risk: Filesystem read on every call slows generation
risk_register.mitigation: Lazy-load + in-memory cache invalidated only on refresh-corpora.mjs run.

related: G6 — predicted-paper builder (uses pastPaperFrequencyCorpus); PR-19 / #83 #84 — audits
